C1770.title: Log4j Exploit WAF Evasion and Data Exfiltration Patterns
C1770.summary: Cloudflare observed that after the Log4j CVE-2021-44228 vulnerability was disclosed, attackers quickly shifted from using simple attack strings to leveraging Log4j Lookups language features (such as ${lower}, ${env}) for WAF evasion, bypassing protection rules based on simple string matching, and attempting to exfiltrate sensitive data including passwords from target process environment variables
